embedded-page-metadata-01.graded_text: Tessel's own wrapper page emits the icon, title, and link preview tags in its initial server-rendered HTML, taken from the person's HTML when it is saved, rather than relying on the person's script or the inner document.

votes.e: C/project/docs/metadata.md:7 "Tessel's outer document owns the tab title, favicon, canonical URL, and social tags... Extract identity when an HTML revision is saved, persist the extraction as a revision-bound cache, and render metadata into the wrapper's initial server response. A scraper must not need JavaScript, iframe traversal, or a signed-in session." and :31 "Ignore imported scripts, HTTP metadata, and declarations inserted later by scripts."

embedded-page-metadata-02.graded_text: Public and unlisted pages get page-specific previews, and unlisted pages keep noindex while still getting their real preview card.

votes.e: C/project/docs/metadata.md:17-18 table: Public "Page-specific title, description, and image | Indexable"; Unlisted "Same as public | Same as public | `noindex, nofollow`; absent from sitemap, feeds, search, and public listings"; :9 "Public and unlisted pages have equally rich link previews."

embedded-page-metadata-03.graded_text: A private page answers any request not authorized for it, link-preview fetchers included, with a generic card that names only the product and carries no title, text, or image from the page.

votes.e: C/project/docs/metadata.md:23 "Generic means exactly title `Tessel`, description `Interactive pages on Tessel.`, Tessel's icon, and a static Tessel brand image. No page name, excerpt, author, workspace, thumbnail..."; :19 private signed-out/nonmember "Generic Tessel card only"; :25 "Do not grant access based on a bot user agent, link-preview service name, or referrer."

embedded-page-metadata-04.graded_text: Preview images are rendered in an environment that cannot write saved data or cause other side effects, and cannot reach private or internal networks or credentials, and a page load no person started, such as a link-preview fetcher running the page's script, cannot add saved data such as a poll vote.

votes.e: C/project/docs/metadata.md:80 "Render the saved revision in a disposable sandbox, with no user cookies, sessions, API keys, auth headers, local storage, service workers, or ambient cloud credentials"; :81 "writes always fail with `PREVIEW_READ_ONLY`... Check permission again at every production mutation boundary; renderer identity has no write capability"; :82 "Deny all direct outbound browser network access... Blocking POST alone is insufficient"; :84 broker blocks "internal/loopback/link-local/metadata addresses, DNS pinning and redirect revalidation"; :87 for third-party crawlers "GET/HEAD in Tessel's own data API never mutate state, and default runtime mutations require an explicit interaction and a server-issued, narrowly scoped viewer capability."

embedded-page-metadata-05.graded_text: A page's own preview image is used when it declares one, and otherwise a preview is generated, so publishing never requires making an image.

votes.e: C/project/docs/metadata.md:39 "Preview image | Valid `og:image`, then `twitter:image`, then automatic generation described below"; :69 "Automatic image: create a deterministic Tessel card immediately... always available"; :11 "No manifest, preview upload, or new metadata form is required."
